definitions.explanation: Describing something of small size. A casual/cute alternative to 小さい.

examples.japanese: ちっちゃい{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have photos from when I was little.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ちっちゃくて{可愛|かわい}い。
examples.english: This bug is tiny and cute.

notes:
ちっちゃい is a casual/cute contraction of ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧. The gemination (っ) adds emphasis and a childlike or affectionate nuance.

REGISTER:
This is casual/colloquial language with a slightly cute nuance. Use ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ in polite or formal contexts.

As an i-adjective: ちっちゃく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (negative), ちっちゃかった (past), ちっちゃく (adverb form).

FORMS:
ちっこい is another casual variant with similar meaning.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ちっちゃい{頃|ころ}: when (I/you/they) was little
- ちっちゃい⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧: a little child

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: ちっちゃくなかったら
